measured_object: empirical geometry of minibatch task gradients and of the counterfactual AdamW writes derived from them (not Hessian / Fisher / natural gradient / manifold / intrinsic dimension)

A.writer: stock OneCycle scheduler, seed 2 (LR warm-up / cosine anneal; beta1 cycled 0.95 -> 0.85 -> 0.95)

B.writer: backward SequenceLR scheduler, seed 2 (reversed LR sequence, beta1 fixed 0.9)

specimens.milestone_contents: {model, opt, step}: state after step s, param-group values used for step s (tee inside AdamW.step, before sched.step)

scheduler_law.parity: serialized lr/beta1/beta2/wd == table row s exactly, read before any target gradient, else STOP and remove the working dir

optimizer_reconstruction.binding: opt.load_state_dict(ckpt['opt']) by module parameter order (digest recorded)
asserts: eps 1e-8, wd 0.01, amsgrad/maximize false, decoupled decay
model + optimizer state digests before and after each cell

virtual_law: c = g * min(1, 1/(||g||+1e-6)); m' = b1 m + (1-b1) c; v' = b2 v + (1-b2) c^2; bc1 = 1-b1^(s+1); bc2 = 1-b2^(s+1); mhat = m'/bc1; a = -lr (m'/bc1)/(sqrt(v'/bc2)+eps); u = -lr wd W + a; u0 = same with c = 0 (zero tensors); b = u - u0 = a - a0

storage.memmap: raw gradients only, float32 (64 x 18911616) per specimen-state, two per state (9.7 GB peak; disk preflight asserted), deleted after reductions
storage.families: derived per tensor block in float64 during the Gram pass

parity_endpoints.synthetic: torch AdamW.step float32 v virtual law: 1.1e-7

readouts: raw FIT spectrum / participation / top-k energy
group energy share + group C_8 (BLOCK0..7 + OUTSIDE)
geometry.distortion: D(x->y) = ||K_y - K_x||_F / ||K_x||_F on unit-row cosine Grams: g->mhat, mhat->a, a->u, g->u, g->b, a->b
geometry.velocity: own next-grid displacement projected on FIT subspaces of g / u / b (descriptive)

ladder.0_resolution: GEOMETRY-NOT-RESOLVED if raw S_8(FIT,HELD) < 0.25 for g or u at any state for either writer
